'''Jan Poleszczuk''' (born 19 October 1986) is a Polish mathematician and biomedical engineer specializing in mathematical modeling in oncology. He is a researcher at the [[:pl:Instytut Biocybernetyki i Inżynierii Biomedycznej im. Macieja Nałęcza Polskiej Akademii Nauk|Nałęcz Institute of Biocybernetics and Biomedical Engineering]] of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] and a laureate of the ''[[Polityka]]'' Science Award (2017). His work concerns tumor growth dynamics, gene-expression modeling and optimization of radio- and chemotherapy.

== Early life and education ==
Poleszczuk was born in Poland on 19 October 1986. He received his Master of Science degree in mathematical methods in biology and social sciences from the [[University of Warsaw]] in 2010, defending a thesis on modeling tumor angiogenesis and anti-angiogenic therapy based on the Hahnfeldt model.<ref name="Forys2012">{{cite journal |last=Foryś |first=Urszula A. |title=Jan Poleszczuk – the Winner of the Polish Mathematical Society's Prize |journal=Mathematica Applicanda |volume=40 |year=2012 |pages=127–130 |doi=10.14708/ma.v40i1.289 |issn=2299-4009}}</ref>

Under the supervision of [[Maria Wideł]] and co-supervision of [[Urszula Alicja Foryś]], he earned a Ph.D. in biocybernetics and biomedical engineering from the [[Silesian University of Technology]] in 2014 for the dissertation ''Mathematical modeling of cancer cell response to therapy-induced stress''. He subsequently obtained a Ph.D. in mathematics from the University of Warsaw in 2015 with the thesis ''Exploring potential tumor growth modulating mechanisms in cells having different status of TP53 gene''.

In 2020 he was awarded the habilitation (D.Sc.) in biomedical engineering by the Nałęcz Institute of Biocybernetics and Biomedical Engineering, Polish Academy of Sciences, for his work ''Mathematical modeling in the study of evolution and treatment of cancer with radio and immunotherapy''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Profil – Ludzie Nauki: dr hab. Jan Poleszczuk |url=https://ludzie.nauka.gov.pl/ln/profiles/jan.poleszczuk.JVxEWfmS7OV |website=Ludzie Nauki |access-date=4 September 2025}}</ref>

== Academic career ==
Since 2012 Poleszczuk has been affiliated with the Nałęcz Institute of Biocybernetics and Biomedical Engineering of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]], where he works on quantitative models of tumor response to therapy and radiobiological optimization. He has also collaborated with the [[Maria Skłodowska-Curie National Research Institute of Oncology]] on mathematical and computational methods in radiotherapy planning.<ref>{{cite web |title=Jan Poleszczuk – Akademia Młodych Uczonych PAN |url=https://amu.pan.pl/en/jan-poleszczuk/ |website=Polish Academy of Sciences Academy of Young Scholars |access-date=23 January 2025 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220724232151/https://amu.pan.pl/en/jan-poleszczuk/ |archivedate=24 July 2022}}</ref>

== Research ==
Poleszczuk has authored or co-authored more than 60 scientific articles indexed in [[MathSciNet]], [[Zentralblatt MATH]], and [[PubMed]]. His most cited works include ''Stochastic models of gene expression with delayed degradation'' (co-authored with Jacek Miȩkisz, Marek Bodnar and Urszula Foryś) published in ''Bulletin of Mathematical Biology'' (2011) and ''Mathematical modelling of immune reaction against gliomas: Sensitivity analysis and influence of delays'' (2013).<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Miȩkisz |first1=Jacek |last2=Poleszczuk |first2=Jan |last3=Bodnar |first3=Marek |last4=Foryś |first4=Urszula |title=Stochastic Models of Gene Expression with Delayed Degradation |journal=Bulletin of Mathematical Biology |volume=73 |issue=9 |pages=2231–2247 |year=2011 |doi=10.1007/s11538-010-9622-4 |pmid=21210242|doi-access=free }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Piotrowska |first1=Monika J. |last2=Bodnar |first2=Marek |last3=Poleszczuk |first3=Jan |last4=Foryś |first4=Urszula |title=Mathematical modelling of immune reaction against gliomas: Sensitivity analysis and influence of delays |journal=Nonlinear Analysis: Real World Applications |volume=14 |issue=3 |pages=1601–1620 |year=2013 |doi=10.1016/j.nonrwa.2012.10.020 |issn=1468-1218}}</ref>

His research integrates mathematical modeling, systems biology, and biomedical engineering to understand interactions between gene mutations and tumor growth and to improve therapeutic protocols in radiotherapy and chemotherapy.

== Awards and membership ==
* Laureate of the ''POLITYKA'' Science Award (2017).<ref>{{cite web |title=Laureate of the POLITYKA Scientific Awards 2017 |url=https://www.polityka.pl/tygodnikpolityka/nauka/nagrodynaukowe/1724374,1,laureat-nagrod-naukowych-polityki-2017.read |website=Polityka |access-date=20 September 2020}}</ref>
* Member of the [[Polish Mathematical Society]] (Treasurer 2017–2020).<ref>{{cite web |title=Polish Mathematical Society – Main Board 2020 |url=https://www.ptm.org.pl/zawartosc/wladze-polskiego-towarzystwa-matematycznego?q=wladze/zarzad-glowny |website=PTM official site |access-date=30 December 2020}}</ref>
* Member of the Polish Radiation Research Society, the [[Society for Mathematical Biology]], and the [[American Association for Cancer Research]].
